title: Pokemon Yellow: Live Battle
logline: Walk Game Boy Pokemon Yellow's Kanto in 3D, drawn like the anime, with Pikachu at your heels, and fight every wild Pokemon, trainer and gym leader in real time: dodge, time four moves and swap mid-fight.
pillars: Battles you fight, not menus you pick
Pikachu is your partner, not a party slot
audience: Players aged 10 and up who grew up with Red, Blue, Yellow and the anime, and action RPG fans who always wanted Pokemon battles to be fought live
references: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

store.tagline: Don't pick the move. Make it.
features: Yellow's whole journey, from Oak's lab to the Hall of Fame, with every route, trainer and Pokemon in its place
Real-time battles: dodge, time four moves and swap mid-fight to a Pokemon that runs, flies or crawls
A seamless, cel-shaded Kanto straight out of the anime, where Pikachu walks with you and every fight happens where you stand
